target: Azoth architecture briefs and high-autonomy pipeline alignment
summary: Architecture briefs should include UX anchor points that translate architectural decisions into user-visible implications and alignment checkpoints before high-autonomy execution proceeds.
evidence: During T-KRP-C scope approval, the human explicitly requested that /auto stop at the architect brief and include a UX Anchor Points section listing UX implications as alignment anchors. The purpose was to let the human understand the architectural level quickly and align efficiently before granting high-autonomy end-to-end execution.
recommended_action: Explore an Azoth operating-model improvement where architect-stage briefs for governed or high-autonomy runs include a dedicated UX Anchor Points section. The section should list user-visible workflow, communication, review, safety, and alignment implications so the operator can approve the design at a higher alignment level without reading raw pipeline internals.
